endpoints.desc: OpenAI-compatible conversational dialogue and multimodal VLM endpoint. Supports streaming, system prompts, JSON mode, and image/video inputs.

params.name: messages
params.desc: Array of message objects (role, content). Content supports text strings or multimodal arrays (text + image_url).

default.content: You are a helpful multimodal AI assistant.

params.name: model
params.desc: Model ID to use for generation.

params.name: stream
params.desc: Whether to stream tokens in real-time via Server-Sent Events (SSE).

params.name: temperature
params.desc: Sampling temperature (0.0 to 2.0).

params.name: max_tokens
params.desc: Maximum number of tokens to generate.

params.name: top_p
params.desc: Nucleus sampling probability threshold.

params.name: keep_alive
params.desc: How long (in seconds) to keep the model loaded in VRAM after request.

endpoints.desc: OpenAI-compatible multimodal dense vector embedding endpoint. Encodes text chunks, search queries, or visual assets into normalized float vectors.

examples.title: cURL
Python (OpenAI Client)
examples.code:
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(base_url='http://localhost:8000/v1', api_key='sk-no-key-required')

response = client.embeddings.create(
    model="bge-m3",
    input=["Semantic retrieval in Rust", "AI inference"]
)
print(f"Embedding dimension: {len(response.data[0].embedding)}")

endpoints.desc: Cross-Encoder document scoring and semantic search re-ranking endpoint. Scores query-document pairs with full bidirectional cross-attention.

params.name: query
params.desc: The search query string to rank candidate documents against.
params.default: What is the capital of France?

params.name: documents
params.desc: List of candidate text documents to score and rank.
default: Paris is the capital and most populous city of France.
London is the capital of the United Kingdom.
Lyon is a major city in south-eastern France.

params.name: model
params.desc: Cross-encoder reranker model ID (e.g. bge-reranker-v2-m3).

params.name: top_n
params.desc: Number of top ranked results to return.

examples.title: cURL
examples.code:
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/v1/rerank \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "query": "How does transformer attention work?",
    "documents": ["Attention is all you need paper introduced self-attention", "Convolutional networks for vision"],
    "top_n": 1
  }'

examples.title: Python
examples.code:
import requests

payload = {
    "query": "How does transformer attention work?",
    "documents": ["Attention is all you need paper introduced self-attention", "Convolutional networks for vision"],
    "top_n": 1
}
res = requests.post('http://localhost:8000/v1/rerank', json=payload)
print(res.json())

endpoints.desc: OpenAI-compatible Text-to-Speech (TTS) neural voice synthesis endpoint. Converts text into high-fidelity speech audio.

params.name: input
params.desc: The text string to synthesize into speech audio.
params.default: Hello, welcome to Cluaiz Sovereign Engine.

params.name: model
params.desc: Neural voice TTS model (e.g. kokoro-82m, piper).

params.name: voice
params.desc: Voice persona (e.g. 'alloy', 'echo', 'fable', 'onyx', 'nova', 'shimmer').

params.name: speed
params.desc: Voice playback speed multiplier (0.25 to 4.0).

params.name: response_format
params.desc: Audio encoding format ('mp3', 'wav', 'opus', 'base64').

examples.title: Python
examples.code:
import requests

res = requests.post('http://localhost:8000/v1/audio/speech', json={
    'model': 'kokoro-82m',

})
